feedback.finish: In April 1856, the Crimean War ended, so the soldiers returned home.

instruction.text: Do you think Mary Seacole stayed in the Crimea after the war ended?

feedback.finish: After the war, Mary’s job in the Crimea was done. She had spent a lot of money to fund her work, so she was now very poor.

instruction.text: Can you spot the bookshelf? Select it to learn more.

finish.text: Mary Seacole wrote a book about her life to try and make some money. The book was called Wonderful Adventures of Mrs Seacole in Many Lands and it was the first autobiography written by a black woman in Britain.
